keyVerse: When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will realize that I AM.
meditation: Jesus declares His divine identity with the sacred name 'I AM,' the same name God revealed to Moses. His crucifixion—being 'lifted up'—will reveal who He truly is. Today, contemplate the cross not as defeat but as the ultimate revelation of God's glory and Jesus' true identity as Lord and Savior.

keyVerse: Behold, I am the handmaid of the Lord. May it be done to me according to your word.
meditation: Mary humbly accepts God's will, opening her heart to the divine mystery. Through her 'yes,' the Incarnation begins. Today, ask yourself: Am I ready to surrender my plans to God's greater purpose? Like Mary, may we say 'yes' with trust and humility.
